page.notes: Greek words in the second paragraph (πιστόν, ἀγαπητόν) are small and slightly blurred; the accents and letters are uncertain and marked [?]. The first line begins mid-word ("tiæ"), so it is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The word "fit" at the lower right is read as a catchword and is uncertain. The underlining of "Quod" is not transcribed. The scan has a dark shadow at the right edge and some show-through, which were ignored.
